notes.title: *New PATCH * - Gamepad Controller Issues and More!
notes.content:
Heya sailors!

We have been working hard trying to solve all the issues that you have been sharing on the forums. Here are the most recent patch notes for today's version.

[b]Gamepad controller issues:[/b]
- Added an option to remap de gamepad controller - [b]Options menu > Game > Remap controller[/b] - There you will be prompted to configure your controller in case the default configuration is not valid for you.
- Added an option to reset the gamepad controller configuration - [b]Options menu > Game > Reset controller configuration[/b] - This option will reset your gamepad controller configuration to default.
- If you are still having issues with the gamepad controller, try to disable any programs like Xinput or DirectInput (if you are using them).

[b]Minor fixes:[/b]
- Fixed issues with the saved data.
- Foxed issues when changing between keyboard/controller input.

Thank you all for your love, your patience and for sending the bug reports. We are still listening and reading all the posts on the forums!

Love,
Team Gotham
:solosapling::soloshiter:
